caption: The drawing depicts a seated figure of a child dressed in a blue robe and a red cape, with a tall black hat adorned with a feather. The figure sits on a simple chair with pointed finials and holds a staff in the right hand and a basket in the left hand. The face is pale and round with black hair visible under the hat. The background includes two dark blue curtain-like drapes forming a triangular shape at the top, partially covering a beige background. The figure is flanked on both sides by two large silver urns containing red and pink flowers with green leaves. Below the scene, there is a beige rectangular section with bold black text reading "EL SANTO NIÑO DE ATOCHA." The overall composition is centered, with the text forming the base of the image and the top portion framed by the dark blue drapes. The drawing employs mainly blue, red, beige, black, and green colors.
title: Retablo-Child's Saint
